translation_method: Three Georgian translation agents produced separate profile batches; an independent Georgian editorial pass checks the merged copy against source data. No external translation service was used.
scope: All printed names, short names, roles, descriptions, summaries, interpretations, realms, labels, legends and print instructions. Full editorial metadata and source commentary remain in the original character JSON.
editorial_review: All35profiles reviewed separately from the translation batches. Corrected marriage grammar, ambiguous pronouns, unsupported wording, and compact dense-card summaries. Native SFGeorgian glyphs embedded, with Arial numerals/punctuation fallback.
